title: Travel Canvas
summary: A shared travel-planning workspace where everyone can contribute to the same trip. Create cards for destinations, activities, accommodations, or ideas, and arrange them along a shared timeline to turn individual suggestions into one collaborative itinerary.
summaryZhTW: 和旅伴一起規劃行程。每個人都能把想去的景點、想參加的活動、住宿選項或旅行點子做成卡片，再把卡片排到共用時間軸上，一起整理出大家的行程。
controls: Create a card and place it on the shared trip timeline.

approval.note: Creator supplied the destination, description, and artwork for the Possibility Apps catalog.

coverAlt: Vintage travel poster overlooking a coastal harbor, with a laptop displaying a shared three-day trip timeline.
